corrections: First ordinary run failed only because a new test tried to enable moderation in memory mode (9.914s). Kept production PG/auth gate and moved full test logic to genuine PG.
First independent PG run (23.693s) exposed reflect.DeepEqual on timestamps with different Location. Replaced with nullable Time.Equal semantics; actual microsecond changes still rejected.

Two intermediate agent PG authorizations crossed in messages; exact process overlap could not be inferred and neither run reported writer-lock contention. All later PG tests, including the final full run, were launched solely by root after prior termination.

Read-only review found READY manifest/thumbnail identity could change while original hash remained unchanged. Added full frozen-receipt and thumbnail byte verification before HTTP; all five tamper cases passed.
The first new tamper fixture accidentally blocked download slot zero (35.776s group failure). Changed only its fixture to nonblocking -1; kept deadlines and assertions.

The versioned-S3 group (30.086s) failed one existing unversioned-loss fixture: ordinary DeleteObject now creates a marker and the bound old version remains available. Kept loss assertions, added marker/readback check and deleted only the exact fixture-created version to simulate actual loss; recheck passed in 0.200s.

New S3 bucket initially exhausted prior four-volume limit; increased bounded local capacity without deleting old objects. First initialization probe timed out and the next explicit bounded probe passed.

Initial helper assumed a root package-lock that does not exist; corrected to apps/workbench/package-lock.json and synchronized metadata without dependency changes. Intermediate compile/HTTP test sequencing failures are preserved in 076/077.
